summary:
Signed in to staging-admin with the provided admin account.
Opened OMS order OMS-2026-02724 on staging-admin and checked its order details.
Found that the order's warehouse status was ready_to_ship and that a second approve action was not available.
Opened the linked outbound record from the OMS order.
On the outbound page, confirmed the status was Waiting for Dispatch and that the Mark Dispatch as Complete button was visible.
Finished on the staging-admin outbound page as requested, without opening the tasks page.
